outages.description: A transmission line trip on the national grid caused a significant drop in Internet traffic across coastal Demerara and Berbice.
Damage to two international fiber optic links on Route Nationale 1 caused a complete outage on Digicel Haiti (AS27653)
A fault on the national grid caused a drop in Internet traffic from Bangladesh, mainly affecting eastern Dhaka and parts of Chattogram.
Ukrainian drone strikes on energy infrastructure caused power outages that disrupted Internet connectivity in Russian-occupied Crimea and Sevastopol
